The '''Trindello-Endor Route''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] in the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]] that ran from the [[Trindello system/Legends|Trindello]] to the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]].

[[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspatial]] travel along this route was very complicated due to the [[Din Pulsar/Legends|Din Pulsar's]] magnetic pulses that damaged [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]].<ref name="TEA" />
